blocks.text: The aesthetic of ghostcore is described as "dark, haunted, and ethereal-like landscapes, cemeteries, the spiritual world and connecting to it, haunted artifacts, dark and mysterious history, legends and ghost stories, and more" according to a private Ghostcore Facebook page.

The visuals of Ghostcore are dark and eerie, evoking a sense of dread and fear of something that is not supposed to be there. Many images appear in black and white, with grainy quality and dimly lit lighting to look worn-out. Areas featured in the aesthetic like as castles, mansions, forests, graveyards or old houses may appear empty and covered in fog to evoke a mysterious but ethereal atmosphere. Bloody handprints would appear on surfaces like mirrors or windows.
Ghosts are often depicted as floating bedsheets or transparent beings with white/black eyes with no corneas.
Examples of ghostcore activities (as described by Tumblr user sleepysheepsy) include:
Staying in one place for a long time
Being easily scared, but stays brave
Being scared of the dark, or super comfy with it
Shy but loves talking with close pals
Hiding and playing hide and seek
Visiting a haunted house or graveyard

Ghostcore fashion can be open to the interpretation and comfort to any individual, as this is not a fashion-centric aesthetic. There can be overlap with aesthetics like Gothic and Morute. However, the community has been open in discussing various fashion tastes and intrigues which include:
Flowing, lightweight gowns and fabrics Typically in white or black
Suits and formalwear as if attending a funeral
